svg.text: Brightloop Subscription Management - Functional Wireframe (Admin / Staff / Customer)

Read left to right. Each box is a screen. Each grey button row is a button: if it has an arrow, clicking it opens the target screen. If it has small grey text underneath, that text is what happens on click.
PUBLIC / AUTH - anyone, no login needed until Login succeeds
ADMIN - controls the whole system (sees every menu item)
STAFF - day-to-day work, limited access (no Products / Plans / Taxes / Discounts / Staff menus)
STAFF (continued) - Admin can open these same screens too
CUSTOMER PORTAL - sees ONLY own subscriptions and invoices
SYSTEM - background billing engine (runs daily, nobody types invoices by hand)
